headline: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
summary: Elon Musk claims Zelenskyy is lying about Starshield disruptions. Musk accuses Ukraine of misusing Starlink for military purposes. Comments made at The New York Times' DealBook Summit.

headline: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
summary: Major US school districts may drop Google Search. Google will link Search to its AI features next year. Schools can't disable Gemini without losing Search access.

headline: Democrats skip a vote on adding Brendan Carr’s adviser to the FCC
summary: Democrats boycotted a Senate committee vote for an FCC nominee. The vote was meant to confirm a Trump nominee, Danielle Thumann Severs. All Republican members were present, but Democratic seats were empty.

headline: Absolute Batman can save DC Studios
summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran are out as DC Studios co-heads after Skydance's acquisition. Uncertainty surrounds the future of the DC cinematic universe. The author suggests Batman is key to DC Studios' revival.

headline: This LEGO Botanical Set Is the Perfect Decoration for Thanksgiving — Now at It's Lowest Price of the Year
summary: A LEGO Botanical Set is now available at its lowest price ever. It's highlighted as a perfect Thanksgiving decoration. This deal is part of current Black Friday promotions.

headline: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Season 1 4K Blu-rays Drop to a New Low Price at Amazon
summary: "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" Season 1 4K Blu-rays are at a new low price. The deal is available on Amazon. This discount is likely a Black Friday promotion.

headline: The LEGO Mandalorian N-1 Starfighter Set Is Getting a Discount After Retirement
summary: The LEGO Mandalorian N-1 Starfighter Set is now discounted. This deal comes after the set's retirement. It's likely part of a Black Friday sale.

headline: The Lord of the Rings Trilogy 4K Extended Edition Is at Its Lowest Price of the Year for Black Friday
summary: "The Lord of the Rings Trilogy" 4K Extended Edition is at its lowest price. This special Black Friday deal is available now. Fans can get the epic series at a significant discount.

headline: Watch: Trump greets 'my friend' Putin as pair shake hands
summary: Donald Trump greeted Vladimir Putin, calling him 'my friend'. The two leaders shook hands. They met ahead of a trilateral meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

headline: McDonald's sex abuse: 'They were waiting for the younger girls to turn 18'
summary: A former McDonald's worker speaks out about alleged sex abuse. A judge ruled a legal case against the chain can proceed. The worker urges McDonald's to improve employee treatment.

headline: Leasehold system set to be scrapped in England and Wales
summary: England and Wales plan to abolish the leasehold system. A new bill will cap ground rent at £250. This reform aims to benefit homeowners.

headline: Google rejects UK request for Russell Brand YouTube video to be removed, sources say
summary: Google reportedly rejected the UK's request to remove a Russell Brand YouTube video. The request followed Brand's wife sharing his claim of innocence. Details of the video and specific reasons for the request are unclear.
